title: Rezoning map change for 108-05 68th Road, Forest Hills
summary: This application would change the zoning map at 108-05 68th Road in Forest Hills, Queens from an R1-2A to an R7A district. It would help allow a seven-story mixed-use building with about 33 apartments, including eight income-restricted units, and 11,500 square feet of community facility space. A related text amendment would create a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for the site.
